prior_threads.reason: Father William marked the witch's home and the Barrow Mound on the map (beat_46), and the party will check a marked location on the way (beat_69), but the treasure is still unfound.

The question is answered: the Clurichen, Naggeneen, was drinking the Golden Egg's alcohol (beat_33). He is captured but not gone, hanging in a bag behind Quinn's bar (beat_34, beat_35), and he offered a pot of gold or a secret for his release.

The lair's location is now known (beat_50). The danger sharpened: the dragon is poisonous, its scales are unpierceable and it will soon fly. The hunt now hinges on Brandon's magic sword (beat_42), and the bounty's payment is in doubt (beat_52).
Lady Hilda was only seen this Session. Sir Phidipaldi's promise to come back and hire her is unreleased.
Ned was only seen this Session, and his offer was not taken up or declined.
Shipments still have not come in, and the cause is unknown.
Eric never accepted the challenge, and the dawn passed with no duel. Sir Phidipaldi's continued disdain (beat_52) does not renew it, and nothing is owed.
Gill will lower Shamus's price once his sons return (beat_3), but Dunk has not yet got the mule.
Dunk scouted the shirt and Warwick's open window (beat_12) and says he has a plan to get it (beat_65), but he does not have it yet.
The ale thief was found to be Naggeneen, not Bentley (beat_33), and Quinn paid the party (beat_34). Nothing remains open.

new_threads.name: Trout's Halfling Corps
new_threads.reason: Squints joined under Trout's terms, including second pick of the first treasure (beat_38), and Brother Dirk now reports to Squints (beat_81). The recruits' standing and the promised share remain open.

new_threads.name: Dunk's sleeping-potion deal with Ingrid
new_threads.reason: Dunk supplied diluted faun wine for a sleeping potion that he will help Ingrid give to Warwick, and the potion and their next meeting are still pending (beat_71). It serves Dunk's stated plan to get Warwick's armor (beat_25, beat_65).

new_threads.name: Brandon's magic sword
new_threads.reason: Father William says the dragon cannot be killed without the sword buried with Brandon (beat_42), which gives it a stated purpose. The party is heading to the Barrow to get it (beat_69).

new_threads.name: Dr. Uriah's penance at the Barrow Mound
new_threads.reason: Dr. Uriah promised Father William to do penance at the Barrow Mound and donate 10 gold, and he has not yet done so.

new_threads.name: The giant in the woods
new_threads.reason: The party rescued Brother Dirk and outran the giant (beat_78). The giant is awake, angry and still on the road to the Barrow, so the danger has not ended.

standalone_beats.reason: Trout's eavesdropping on the adventurers' table identified who was there but advanced no thread.
Learning the wizard's name, Malzatarik the Magnificent, ties to no thread.
Ingrid's wares are a usable resource tied to no thread.
Father William's hostility toward Dr. Uriah as a Dagonite was consequential but led to no thread of its own.
Father William's offer to heal Dr. Uriah is a resource with no thread.
Ingrid's report that fairies are emerging and that she visits Vivian in the forest is background with no thread.
Dr. Uriah's purchase of wolfsbane and mandrake tea serves no thread.
